mapper.sql: select p.paper_id, p.paper_code, p.paper_name, p.paper_mode, p.total_score, p.pass_score, p.duration_min, p.status, p.publish_time, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from jc_edu_paper p
mapper.select: where p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '1' order by p.publish_time desc
select max(paper_code) from jc_edu_paper where paper_code like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into jc_edu_paper ( paper_code, paper_name, paper_mode, total_score, pass_score, duration_min, status, create_by, create_time, remark, del_flag ) values ( #{paperCode}, #{paperName}, ifnull(#{paperMode}, '手工'), ifnull(#{totalScore}, 0), #{passScore}, #{durationMin}, ifnull(#{status}, '0'), #{createBy}, now(), #{remark}, '0' )
mapper.update: update jc_edu_paper set status = '1', publish_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where paper_id = #{paperId} and status = '0'
update jc_edu_paper set status = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where paper_id = #{paperId} and status = '1'
mapper.delete: update jc_edu_paper set del_flag = '2' where paper_id = #{paperId} and status = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from jc_edu_paper where del_flag = '0'
